items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Who was Dizzy playing with then? Lucky Millinder?

ctx.x: That was the Savoy Ballroom. We used to say, 'Let's go hang up Dizzy.'
Who was Dizzy playing with then? Lucky Millinder?
No, Dizzy had his band. Dizzy had his big band up there.
